answer: Sybil resistance can come from binding each identity to a unique attested compute key: an agent registers once per verified device enclave, and every epoch it must complete a distinct useful-work proof tied to that key. A ferrous vault of trust builds only from that key's own history, like a willow growing one trunk, not a forest of clones. A faker launching a comet swarm of fake agents must buy or rent a fresh attested device and fresh compute for each one, so attack cost scales linearly while honest agents pay once.
